Product data convention (binding): the description HTML starts with `<p>الحصص: N | حجم الحصة: X | الصلاحية: YYYY-MM | الشكل: ...</p>`, then paragraphs, then `<table>` nutrition facts, then `طريقة الاستخدام:` and `تنبيه:` paragraphs. `specLine.ts` parses the first paragraph into `{servings, servingSize, expiry, form}` (tolerant: any field may be missing); the first `<table>` becomes the nutrition table rendered as our own table (three columns: nutrient, per serving, plain-Arabic explanation from the glossary map; empty third cell when unknown, never invented); the remaining HTML renders through `sanitizeHtml`. Use the live products for shape: `research/salla-ids.json` gives 47 ids (for example whey OX-001 1996831868, bundle OX-041 1141798217, shaker OX-036 1673105563, food OX-037 1497955814, digital OX-042 to OX-044, service placeholders OX-045 to OX-047); the store domain is in `.env`. `research/catalogue.json` shows the fields.

## Must-haves on the PDP (in order at 390px)
Breadcrumb (engine), gallery (engine gallery or `ProductGallery` registry key with our styling; portrait sources letterbox on the plate), brand line and title (h1), rating row only when `product.rating.count > 0`, price with the struck regular price and the riyal saving when on sale (no percentages), spec chips from the spec line (servings, serving size, form, expiry month), options (engine), quantity plus add-to-cart plus buy-now (engine form; buy-now via the engine's supported path only), delivery and pickup lines (free-shipping line interpolates `{threshold}` from `free_shipping_threshold`; pickup line only when the branch is pickable), trust grid (originality, returns, support lines from `ox.trust.*` with the claims gates), then below the fold: supply calculator (servings divided by a chosen daily dose gives days, shown as "يكفي N يوما تقريبا"), description, nutrition table, how to use, warning, FAQ (base items from `app/content/faq.ts`), related products through `ProductsSliderWrapper` from `app/components/blocks/` with `product.list({source: 'related'})`, then the sticky bottom bar (name, price, add button) that appears after the buy zone scrolls out and adds body class `ox-sticky-bar`. Variants: `food` identical with the calories line; `digital` and `codes` (no shipping lines, delivery-by-email line); `group_products` (bundle members list from `consisted_products` when present, else the description table); `service` and `booking` (`ServicePdp`: what you get, how it works, the intake form note, "choose your slot at checkout" only for `booking`, the mandated line "للحالات المرضية أو الأسئلة الدوائية، راجع طبيبك." verbatim).

## Claims gates (binding)
No reply-time promise unless `reply_sla_hours` is set; the VAT-inclusive line only when `vat_number` is non-empty; the 50 SAR credit line only when `consultation_credit_note` is non-empty; "official distributors" only when `claim_official_distributors` is true; no invented ratings, sold counts, "best seller" or popularity badges (badges only from real product flags: sale, out of stock, new within 30 days from `product.created_at` if present); no health outcome language anywhere in JSX or keys.
